title: The Borough

authorInfo.bio: George Crabbe (1754–1832) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "The Borough" by George Crabbe is a poetic narrative likely written in the early 19th century. The work serves as a comprehensive portrayal of a fictional seaside town, exploring its landscapes, social dynamics, and the lives of its inhabitants.
